title: Meh
body:
On the one hand, the app is simple and easy to understand. On the other hand, it works badly: it is constantly lagging, I can't go back more than 2 weeks.
Without premium it is useless at all. But any motivation quickly disappears. You just start to open it once a week to put or skip ticks and that's it.
I’d like to have more interracting
author: Nnnjjjttt
